end.summary:
• Practised multiplying numbers ending in zeros by multiplying non-zero parts and counting zeros; some examples were right, but the method was not steady yet.
• Practised using powers of 10 to judge product size and digit count; this is still building and needs checking next time.
• Rudra mixed up zeros already present in the non-zero product with the zeros from the factors.
• The zero-counting mix-ups remained at the last seen attempts; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised breaking products into non-zero parts and then counting the zeros, including examples such as 2,500 × 40 and 3,000 × 400. Rudra gave some right starting steps, but continued to mix up zeros already present in a product such as 25 × 4 = 100 with the zeros from the factors; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, practise three examples by writing the non-zero multiplication and the factor zeros in separate steps before combining them.
